example.title: Creased
lines: Every roof was once a page. Some still remember the words.
When the wind comes, the whole town rustles.
Do not get it wet.

world.title: Serenity
lines: The whispers of the wind carry secrets to the trees.
The sun ascends, casting a golden hue.
In the distance, a castle stands, its shadow long.
A bird flies low, its wings painted with the dawn.

world.title: Silent Shadows
lines: Shadows stretch and shift with the wind.
The night holds its secrets in the darkness.
Leave behind the light of the world.

world.title: Crystal Cove
lines: The sun's first light paints the cove with a golden glow.
The winding staircase leads to the lighthouse on the cliff.
The waves gently lap against the sandy shore.
Shadows stretch long under the ship's prow, catching the morning light.
In the distance, the bush bursts into vibrant blooms of color.
A shark leaps from the water, its silhouette aglow in the sun.
The ship's crew stirs to adapt to the new day.

world.title: Enchanted Forest
lines: The forest whispered secrets of old.
In every twig, a story untold.
The moon watches the shadows dance.
Do not tread on the mist.

world.title: Orchard
lines: The sun rises with the promise of new beginnings.
Every leaf breathes as the world awakens.
With each step, the forest blurs into mirrors.

world.title: Orchard
lines: The sun rose on the fields, painting the wheat with a golden hue.
The sheep grazed under the sky, their wool turning a soft shade of grey.

world.title: Cavern
lines: The walls whispered secrets of the ages,
A cold wind crunched the stone, silent and deep.
In the darkness, the echoes of a long past.

world.title: Shadowy Hollow
lines: The shadows stretch for the sky.
In the fog, the world remains a mystery.
Do not be afraid as you pass.

world.title: Watershed
lines: Sunrise on the watershed, the day begins anew.
With each splash, the river sings its song.
Life whispers in the breeze.

world.title: Silence
lines: The silence is thick as stone.
In the darkness, a whisper calls.
Do not touch the cold stone.

world.title: Hidden Realm
lines: The air is crisp and clean, the light dancing upon the ice.
A gentle breeze carries the smell of the forest far and wide.

world.title: Quill's Echo
lines: The quill writes through time, its echo still here.
Each stroke burns with ancient light.
In the silence, a whisper echoes.

world.title: Orchard
lines: The sun is so bright, it makes the birds happy.
The cats love to play with the piano.
The book is always open in the sun.
They all enjoy the lamp, it casts a soft glow.
The grass is green, it's like a masterpiece.

world.title: Orchard
lines: Whispers of magic drift through the air.
Every leaf holds a secret.
The longer you stand here, the more stories you hear.

world.title: The Whispering Grove
lines: The whisper of the wind carries secrets deep within.
Each stone tells a story, many tales untold.
The moon watches over this place, always in silence.

world.title: Orchid Grotto
lines: In the heart of the orchid grove, the night whispers secrets.
Silent paths lead to blossoms, where dew and shadows dance.
The forest calls with tales of moonlit nights.
The stones hold stories, old and untold.

console.prompt: In the orchid grove, listen to nature's songs.

world.title: A Crust of Dust
lines: The world is too small for the shadows that crawl.
In the quiet, the shadows whisper of what might have been.
The world is too small for the sand that crumbles.
The world is too small for the past that we forget.

world.title: Shadows
lines: The moon sets, the night falls.
The shadows stretch and grow.
The cats slip away.

world.title: Serenity
lines: Tonight, the stars are my friends.
The moon is watching over me.
Rest and find peace.

world.title: Eclipse
lines: Only the stars will see our shadows.
Silence fills the night, the moon is the only light.
One day, you will come.
The river whispers secrets to the stone.
In the heart of eternity, a bridge stands ready.

world.title: A Place
lines: The sun rises over the horizon, casting a warm glow over every blade of grass.
In the distance, the sound of waves turns into the distant hum of a concert.
As the sun climbs higher, the forests turn into a sea of golden leaves.
The concert hall is filled with music making the world sing.
